## Summary / Resumo

Describe what changed and why. Descreva o que mudou e por quê.

## Multilingual content checklist / Checklist de conteúdo multilíngue

- [ ] Every affected PT-BR, EN, or ES file/module has equivalent updates in the other supported locales.
- [ ] Todo arquivo ou módulo PT-BR, EN ou ES afetado possui atualizações equivalentes nos demais idiomas.
- [ ] Shared multilingual README sections were updated together.
- [ ] Slugs, structure, links, metadata, and module order remain aligned.
- [ ] `studio/sources.json` and current-state references were updated when applicable.
- [ ] Original files under `ref/` remain unchanged unless explicitly in scope.

## Validation / Validação

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-content.mjs`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-video-slides.mjs`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-language-parity.mjs <base-commit>`
